name: Knotless Starmap
description: Untangle a fixed-edge constellation by moving its labelled stars until no non-incident luminous edges cross.
natural_language: Drag stars to untangle the fixed edges. Keep stars separate and edges free of crossings or overlaps, then certify the map. Use only screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.

metadata.notes: Original seeded planar-graph construction grounded in PLOG-040 / Jason Davies Planarity. The visible task preserves the fixed graph while accepting any nondegenerate crossing-free embedding; automated implementation evidence only, with human usability and empirical agent difficulty pending.
